Can he be so glad to see me? Kalya wondered, feeling pleased. We may note here in passing
that Alyosha's appearance had undergone a complete change since we saw him last. He
had abandoned his cassock and was wearing now a well-cut coat, a soft, round hat, and
his hair had been cropped short. All this was very becoming to him, and he looked quite
His charming face always had a good-humored expression, but there was a gentleness and
serenity in his good humor. To Kalya's surprise, Alyosha came out to him just as he was, without
an overcoat. He had evidently come in haste. He held out his hand to Kalya at once.
